hypothesis: Diagnosis (docs/collaboration/reports/edge-back-diagnosis-20261030.md): val is 96% eBay but train eBay units are 37 of 130 (14 normal), and run2 val AUC was 0.493. Train mass dominated by screenshot/PSA photos may mismatch the eBay scoring domain.
change: Only the training mass changes: eBay units (group starts with ebay) get total mass equal to all non-eBay units, then positive/negative total mass is balanced as before. Same data (manifest 20261030c, 130 train units), head, L2=1, threshold .5, val rows and reference. Fixed factor by formula, no search.
success_criterion: Val back edge (117 positive, 158 normal): FN<=6 and FP<=15 at threshold .5. Informative improvement over earlier runs requires FN<=38 and FP<=63 (the better of the two earlier runs on both) with at least one lower; AUC reported as secondary (run1 0.679, run2 0.493).
failure_criterion: FN>6 or FP>15 is not adopted. No change to the factor, threshold or data after seeing scores; separation, hash or convergence failure stops before val scoring.
